_comment: Regression baseline for the Astro Max RL TRAINING half. scripts/ci/check_rl_stats.py compares a fresh training run against this and FAILS if a guarded stat regresses. The learning metrics gate with absolute floors under the spread four seed-42 runs measured on 2026-09-25, success_rate 0.987 to 1.000 and mean reward 124 to 127 (nexus#15): a pinned seed gives a policy draw, not a policy, but these statistics over the 2048 envs are tight. Wall-clock stats (steps_per_sec, train_seconds) print as monitored and never gate: no throughput baseline holds on a shared runner. The deploy-side gates live with the examples evaluation harness in scripts/ci/examples_baselines.json (goto_policy, goto_policy_fresh).
